name: Fujima Ren
source:
Likes: Playing video games on his Nyantindo, doing housework, being praised for his talents as a housewife.

Ren is [url=/c33068]Emiri[/url]'s older brother and has been [url=/c33067]Riria[/url]'s friend since the cradle. He is also very close to her mother [url=/c38917]Reika[/url] who also raised him for much of his life. He has known [url=/c33070]Arle[/url] for a long time because she is his sister's childhood friend, she used to call him Ren-oniisan. Nowadays, Ren is a second-year student who is in the same high school as [url=/c33071]Miyabi-senpai[/url] a student of overwhelming popularity, [url=/c38913]Rin[/url]'s friend a Kouhai who is in the same class as Emiri and Arle. He is, as well as the classmate of Riria, the classmate of [url=/c33069]Yuu[/url], a newly transferred student, in the class of the teacher [url=/c38915]Tama-chan[/url].

With incredible gifts in all household chores and his talents as a cook make him the ideal woman and daughter-in-law that all mothers would wish for their sons. He also has a huge sister complex limited to the admiration he has for her though, always finding her very cute. Actually, he has a weakness for everything he finds cute and every girl with a cute reaction make melts his heart. 

He is also very vulnerable to the charms of mature women, in particular Reika, having almost dizzying sexual fantasies about her but recovering quickly before his brain imagines crazy things about her.

"So you're set on calling me, a guy, the ideal 'bride', huh?"
